001package io.jstach.rainbowgum.otlp;
002
003import java.util.Locale;
004
005import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProperty;
006import io.jstach.rainbowgum.annotation.EnumAlias;
007
008/**
009 * Whether the standard OpenTelemetry environment variables ({@code OTEL_SERVICE_NAME},
010 * {@code OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES}, and {@code OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_*}) are read. Off by
011 * default: reading the process environment has to be enabled explicitly. Properties set
012 * directly always take precedence over environment variables.
013 */
014public enum EnvironmentVariables {
015
016        /**
017         * Environment variables are ignored (the default).
018         */
019        @EnumAlias("false")
020        OFF,
021        /**
022         * Environment variables are read for any value not set by a property.
023         */
024        @EnumAlias("true")
025        ON;
026
027        /**
028         * Parses a property value: {@code on}/{@code true} or {@code off}/{@code false}, case
029         * insensitive.
030         * @param value property value.
031         * @return parsed value.
032         * @throws IllegalArgumentException if the value is not recognized.
033         */
034        public static EnvironmentVariables parse(String value) {
035                String v = value.strip();
036                return switch (v.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT)) {
037                        case "true" -> ON;
038                        case "false" -> OFF;
039                        default -> LogProperty.enumValue(EnvironmentVariables.class, v, "true", "false");
040                };
041        }
042
043}
